name: embedding-build
description: Build tooling for aux4/embedding (the published package lives in package/)

scripts.build: cd package/lib && npm install && rm -rf node_modules/onnxruntime-web && find node_modules/onnxruntime-node/bin -name 'DirectML.dll' -delete && find node_modules/onnxruntime-node/bin -name 'dxil.dll' -delete && find node_modules/onnxruntime-node/bin -name 'dxcompiler.dll' -delete
